detail.title: Patient Detail
detail.description: Complete patient profile including biographical and identity card information.

alert.title: Sensitive Patient Data
alert.description: This page contains confidential information including national identity numbers (NIK). Creating an IHS record is a one-way, irreversible action that submits patient data to the national health system.

createDialog.title: Create IHS Patient?
createDialog.description: This creates one-way communication to IHS and cannot be undone.
createDialog.success: The IHS patient has been submitted successfully, Please check on SIMGOS regularly.

notFound.title: Patient Not Found
notFound.description: No patient data was returned for this record number. The patient may not exist or the server encountered an error.
